identity_policy: Study-defined NC2 concrete formulation from Domagala et al. (2024), distinct from the already cataloged NC1 formulation by cement, water and superplasticizer input quantities and nominal water/cement ratio. Table 1 reports NC2 cement 470, water 174 and superplasticizer 1.9 kg/m^3 with nominal w/c 0.37, versus NC1 cement 377, water 208 and superplasticizer 0 kg/m^3 with nominal w/c 0.55. These are different mixture recipes, not extra identities for moisture state, curing age or a translated label. Not all normal-weight concrete or all CEM I 42.5 R cement; the cement designation identifies a constituent, not a certified final-concrete grade.
